mapper.select: SELECT board_id FROM boards WHERE name = #{name} LIMIT 1

SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.title FROM ( SELECT s.post_id, MAX(s.final_score) AS score FROM stats_post_hourly s WHERE s.board_id = #{boardId} AND s.is_trending = 1 AND s.stat_hour >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY s.post_id ) t JOIN posts p ON p.post_id = t.post_id AND p.state = 'normal' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trending_notify_log l WHERE l.post_id = p.post_id) ORDER BY t.score DESC, p.post_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.title FROM posts p WHERE p.board_id = #{boardId} AND p.state = 'normal' AND p.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trending_notify_log l WHERE l.post_id = p.post_id) ORDER BY (p.view_count + 5 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_likes l WHERE l.post_id = p.post_id) + 3 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id AND c.state = 'normal')) DESC, p.post_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT u.user_id FROM users u WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.ban_status <> 'permanent' -- 알림 받을 기기를 등록한 회원만 (PM 2026-10-19 "기기 등록 안 한 사람한테는 발송 안 하고 싶다") — 없으면 어차피 닿지 않는데 발송 수에만 잡혔다 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notification_devices d WHERE d.user_id = u.user_id) -- 이 글을 이미 읽은 회원·작성자는 뺀다 (PM 2026-10-25). 미접속 조건만으로는 미접속 기간 전에 읽은 사람이 남는다 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts p WHERE p.post_id = #{postId} AND p.user_id = u.user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM post_views v WHERE v.post_id = #{postId} AND v.user_id = u.user_id) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM stats_access_hourly a WHERE a.user_id = u.user_id AND a.access_hour >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{activeWithinDays} DAY) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM stats_access_hourly s WHERE s.user_id = u.user_id AND s.access_hour >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) )
